scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic. The included numerical program checks specializations and the ball-segment expansion but is not used as a substitute for the infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-dimensional asymptotics only; no uniformity in dimension, no claim for more than three defining points, and no claim for sampling domains other than Euclidean balls. The planar second coefficient is prior-covered and is used only as a consistency check.
title: Second-order circumradius tails for three random points in a Euclidean ball
